verdict.rationale: Operating an IAM product through natural-language commands is a fair axis, since any admin tool could ship an NL or AI assistant, so this is "none" rather than "na". The evidence documents only conventional interfaces: the admin console, the kcadm.sh Admin CLI, the Admin REST API and the operator. None of these is a first-party natural-language interface, and the probes found no llms.txt or other AI-oriented artifacts.
